mentions.name: HN Column View
mentions.description: This app provides an alternate column-based reading view for Hacker News with resizable font options, built as a personal hobby project.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Column view for hacker news with resizable fonts. It’s just a fun hobby thing for me. I’m not in software, but I can do hobby level programming and that gets leveled up by codex.

https://hn.orbitalchicken.com
